core: Both communities compute a metric that tracks whether intermediate claims or assertions an agent makes during a task persist unverified/unreconciled through to the end of execution, rather than being checked or resolved before the trace concludes.
quote_1: the claim survival tally on the pothole runs was even worse than the clean baseline — the recovery process itself seems to generate a burst of new unverified notes that don't get reconciled
quote_2: Intermediate assertion persistence ratio was computed over all scratchpad claims retained in the execution trace.
